items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...by a man named Paul Deville... [INTERVIEWEE] Saxophone book?

ctx.x: Oh, he had me ... the usual basic training, you know, to learn an instrument, he gets you a book. The book that I used at that time was the Ben Verekin book which is still a very good book today, and I think to get a 1917 copyright on it, I think, the last time I looked at it.

Can you remember any other instructional books? There's another famous one that's been republished and re-edited from time to time by a man named Paul Deville, which has come under various covers, which is a gigantic, ...
